items.prompt: A learner formats each EMA state to four decimals, parses that text back to float, and uses it in the next update. Why can later public outputs disagree?

options.text: Formatting necessarily changes the input price order.
options.why: The described change affects numeric state, not record order.

options.text: Rounded state is fed back into a different recurrence.
options.why: Keep the full internal float and format only the output copy; repeated quantization changes later inputs to the recurrence.

options.text: The public task requires integer-only arithmetic.
options.why: This EMA contract explicitly uses ordinary double arithmetic, unlike the exact integer window-mean extension.

options.text: It removes the need to seed from the first price.
options.why: Initialization is still part of the contract; output formatting cannot replace it.

items.explanation: Keep the full internal float and format only the output copy; repeated quantization changes later inputs to the recurrence.
